title: Define fail-closed certification promotion rules
objective: Define a pure deterministic promotion decision that can move a certification lifecycle from CERTIFICATION_READY to CERTIFIED only when exact-head, selected assurance, canonical provenance, native attestation and explicit PASS verdict evidence all agree on one immutable candidate identity.
non_goals: promote Lot45 or any business candidate
mutate a candidate branch or pull request
change canonical provenance or domain integrity semantics

required_invariants: promotion is a pure decision and never mutates Git PR lifecycle business state or runtime capability
source lifecycle state must be CERTIFICATION_READY and target state may be CERTIFIED only on complete PASS evidence
candidate id head SHA and risk class must agree across lifecycle exact-head assurance provenance attestation and verdict inputs
exact-head evidence must be fresh successful and bound to the candidate head
all selected T3 and T4 requirements must be satisfied with no missing control or manual review
canonical provenance identity must validate and preserve separate domain integrity digests
native attestation subject digest must equal canonical provenance identity and must be bound to the same candidate head
explicit certification verdict must be PASS and cryptographically bind candidate exact-head bundle and provenance identity
missing stale failed duplicate mismatched extra or unknown evidence fails closed
promotion decision never unlocks business development Lot46 live execution leverage or withdrawals
acceptance_criteria: a complete synthetic exact-head candidate produces PROMOTION_ALLOWED with target CERTIFIED
CERTIFICATION_READY is the only promotable source state
head or candidate mismatch anywhere produces PROMOTION_DENIED
missing selected T3 or T4 requirement produces PROMOTION_DENIED
failed stale or wrong-head CI evidence produces PROMOTION_DENIED
missing or mismatched native attestation evidence produces PROMOTION_DENIED
promotion output contains no business unlock or runtime-execution authority field
no Lot45 state branch PR or Lot46 lock is mutated during qualification

done_when: promotion decision is deterministic pure and fail-closed
all exact-head assurance provenance attestation and verdict bindings agree before CERTIFIED is allowed
adversarial mismatch stale missing and failure cases are rejected
business development and execution safety remain unchanged
